rateLimit.notes: in milliseconds. Applies to market-data fetches only; orders are not throttled by this.

thresholds.notes: Liquidity thresholds: $75M minimum 24H combined volume, 0.15% maximum bid-ask spread, 0.5% maximum PERP-SPOT spread, 5% minimum funding APY (filters negative and low funding)

risk.notes: startupCleanupMode: report-only, hedge-only, or hedge-or-close. Managed spot symbols default to trading.pairs mapped to SPOT symbols. Set managedSpotSymbols only to override that default.

notes.description: Trading configuration for Hyperliquid spot and perp markets
notes.pairFormat: All pairs use PERP symbol naming convention
notes.spotMapping: Use symbolMapping.perpToSpot to get corresponding spot symbol
notes.orderSizes: Minimum order sizes per symbol defined in minOrderSizeUSD - positions will not open if insufficient capital
notes.leverage: Always uses 1x leverage (set per-pair before opening positions)
notes.bot: minHoldTimeDays: days before a non-emergency switch (default 7 = the 7d funding window). switchHorizonDays: effective days a 7d-avg funding gap is earned (default 8, measured; re-estimate with tests/check-switch-calibration.js). A switch happens only when gap x horizon beats fees + spread.
notes.rebalance: maxBalanceImbalancePercent: before opening, |PERP - SPOT| / (PERP + SPOT) x 100 of free USDC must be <= this (10 = 50/50 +-5 points), else the bot is ON HOLD (no trade, no exposure) and rebalance-status.json (next to the state file) says ACTION_REQUIRED with the exact manual transfer. Rule of thumb: rebalance when imbalance > D/H, D = your response time, H = mean holding time (~25 days): 2% for D=12h, 10% for D~2.5 days.
notes.paper: Paper trading only (PAPER_TRADING=1): starting USDC per account and the simulated delay of the manual PERP<->SPOT transfer. Ignored by the live bot.
